title: kate-fileio: count a lone CR in a line position
summary: line_col_at treats a lone CR as a line break. A CR LF pair stays one break. An LF stays one break. The test goes in the existing encode tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: encode.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Change only line_col_at. A lone LF starts the next line. A lone CR starts the next line. A CR LF pair is one break, and the next line starts after the LF. Do not count U+2028, VT, FF, or NEL. Do not write three arms that each add one to the line.  Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Update the doc sentence on line_col_at. The old sentence says the text uses LF line endings. The new sentence says a lone LF, a lone CR, or one CR LF pair starts the next line. You may update that sentence. Do not touch wire_char_to_src_char or to_wire_form. The existing tests a_crlf_pair_becomes_one_ending and a_trailing_cr_counts_as_an_ending stay green. Do not rewrite their assertions. The test a_lone_cr_starts_the_next_line checks line_col_at of a, CR, b at index 2 is line 1 column 0. line_col_at of a, CR, LF, b at index 2 is line 0 column 2. The same string at index 3 is line 1 column 0. line_col_at of a, LF, b at index 2 is line 1 column 0. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: encode::tests::a_lone_cr_starts_the_next_line
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. The scalar after a lone CR is line 0 column 2. After the change it is line 1 column 0. A CR LF pair stays one break.
